channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Neil Olshey | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Neil Olshey from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on Neil Olshey's firing:

“Obviously, it was kind of a tough day at the practice facility. Naturally, with the investigation people were anticipating what might happen.”

Chauncey Billups on Neil Olshey, Dec 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Jusuf Nurkic on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Jusuf Nurkic on Neil Olshey and the investigation:

“All I know is what's in the release. I can't really say anything else. As far as relationship, I don't think we have one. It's professional. That's it.”

Jusuf Nurkic on Neil Olshey, Nov 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Sean Highkin:Chauncey Billups on the Vulcans’ investigation into Neil Olshey:

“Obviously, it’s an unfortunate time. All I know is what I’ve read. There’s not much more I can say about it. I think it caught a lot of people off guard.”

Chauncey Billups on Neil Olshey, Nov 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Mark Bartelstein on Neil Olshey
item.description:
“We’re extremely appreciative of how hard (Portland President) Neil Olshey worked with us to accommodate what we were trying to accomplish in this sign and trade,”

Mark Bartelstein on Neil Olshey, Jul 3, 2019. Source: Twitter @wojespn.

item.title: LaMarcus Aldridge on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Aldridge:

“I just block it out and go to the gym. That's it. I can't do anything about that. I feel like if there was really something serious going on, [Trail Blazers general manager] Neil [Olshey] would have told me but that didn't happen. I'm a Trail Blazer.”

LaMarcus Aldridge on Neil Olshey, Aug 31, 2013. Source: CSNNW.com.

item.title: Chris Kaman on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Chris Kaman:

“The last three days I’ve been going back and forth between Portland and Dallasand I know (Portland general manager) Neil Olshey up there pretty well”

Chris Kaman on Neil Olshey, Jul 12, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Larry Miller on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Jeff Zillgitt:In release from Blazers, Miller said:

“We have an excellent general manager in place in Neil Olshey, so I feel the team is on solid ground.”

Larry Miller on Neil Olshey, Jul 7, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nolan Smith on Neil Olshey, Damian Lillard
item.description:
Chris Haynes:Nolan Smith on Olshey calling Lillard a franchise player:

“Welcome to the NBA, the world of ultimate competition. I'm ready 4 Summer League”

Nolan Smith on Neil Olshey, Damian Lillard, Jun 29, 2012. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Larry Miller on Neil Olshey
item.description:
Blazers president Larry Miller on Neil Olshey hiring:

“We spent a lot of time making sure we found the right person. I'm excited we've been able to do that with Neil Olshey. Neil comes to us with the Los Angeles Clippers where he's had the opportunity to build an incredible team down there.... Probably no one is more excited than I am. I've been tired of going through this process and getting hit with questions.”

Larry Miller on Neil Olshey, Jun 5, 2012. Source: Sulia.
